title: DHL Group employee data copied in breach of a survey provider
date_note: Reported November 18; DHL says the incident occurred on November 2.
summary: DHL Group said attackers broke into a provider that runs internal employee surveys and downloaded selected master data of employees: names, age, business and some private e-mail addresses, and organisational information. DHL says passwords, tax, salary and bank data were not affected. Turkey's data protection authority reports 10,622 affected employees in Turkey.
plain: Hackers got into a company that runs DHL staff surveys and copied employees' names and e-mail addresses. DHL says no passwords or bank details were taken.
exec: Third-party breach exposing employee data of a global logistics group; raises targeted phishing risk.
action: DHL employees: treat unexpected messages with caution and verify senders before sharing data.
impact: 10,622 employees in Turkey reported affected by Turkey's data protection authority; DHL has about 584,000 employees.

validation.note: heise report citing DHL and the Turkish authority.

review.note: Provider, data types, unaffected data and Turkey 10,622 figure match heise; Nov 2 incident date is in date_note
